items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript
items.q: My mother played guitar, drum, bass, piano, harmonica, juice, harp. She also danced and sung. So this is where all my teaching mostly really started from.

ctx.x: Uh, somebody told me that your mother played piano a lot.
My mother played guitar, drum, bass, piano, harmonica, juice, harp. She also danced and sung. So this is where all my teaching mostly really started from.
So you've been playing as long as you can remember?
